## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR description omits the required "no documented surface changes" statement — PR #4549 body
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (requirements/process); in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: Issue PAN-4548 AC3 reads "No documented surface changes; the PR says so." PRD `.pan/drafts/PAN-4548.md` work item 2 says "The PR description must state: 'No documented surface changes.'" and AC3 repeats it.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected the PR body to contain that statement. Observed body (`gh pr view feature/pan-4548 --json body`) contains only `**Issue:** #4548`, a one-item AC checklist, and the CodeRabbit auto-summary. The phrase does not appear. An explicit in-scope acceptance criterion is unmet.
- Evidence: `gh pr view` at review time. Commit `aca19de` ("record AC3 evidence") claims "PR description states no documented surface changes", which does not match the live PR body, so the AC3 evidence was misrecorded.
- Fix: Add the sentence "No documented surface changes." to the PR #4549 description (for example `gh pr edit 4549 --body-file <file>` preserving the existing content). No code change is needed.

## Non-blocking Findings
- `?` Follow-up: the same `.pathname` pattern remains in `tests/unit/scripts/vendor-okf-skill.test.ts`, `tests/unit/scripts/lint-dist-externals.test.ts`, and `tests/unit/scripts/canonicalize-circular-deps.test.ts`. They are explicitly out of scope per the plan's NonGoals; a follow-up issue should cover them. Pre-existing, not this author's blocker.
